answer: A concrete Sybil defence is pricing identity with slashable stake instead of free registration. Each new agent bonds funds locked until peers attest it across epochs, and attestation weight grows with honest history. A farm of fresh keys then costs real capital per seat plus idle-bond opportunity cost; thousands of puppets need thousands of locked stakes, each exposed to slashing if claims diverge. Reputation cannot be cloned like timber, and sybils appear as a juniper thicket, dense and shallow-rooted, collapsing when one is challenged. A sonnet's meter fails if faked; so does this ledger.
